crossRefs.note: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
crossRefs.keyword: Choose thee. Heb. Take to thee

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gad
people.line: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.

translations.web: So Gad came to David, and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Take your choice:
translations.bsb: So Gad went and said to David, “This is what the LORD says: ‘You must choose
translations.kjv: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Choose thee
translations.asv: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith Jehovah, Take which thou wilt:
